title: Stage helper544 after a returning producer excursion; improve conditional kappa
body:
This changes the retimed PR3682 construction: stage helper544 after a temporary donor producer excursion, raise its entrance rank from 1 to 2, and reduce its hosted width from 8 to 7. The exact dirty-prefix identity, actual frame assignment, inverse cleanup, both native words and a new literal T360 packing are retained.

The complete conditional endpoint is **kappa = 0.001730448360207635461740 - 10^-46 - 10^-70**, an increase of **0.000000029460441564297936** (about 0.0017%) over PR3682 on the same release grid. The claimed bound uses the actual integer packing, not the higher ideal packing ceiling. It includes 1,321,920 literal roles and 323,069 physical families.

Validation:
- Both changed providers passed fresh native forward/backward, wrapper and phase checks.
- Exact arbitrary-dirty word semantics, 91 dirty buffers, constructive controls, and independent literal owner/window/family/prefix/invoice audits passed.
- Complete original strict supplier admission and modern outer release passed. The first release hit the inherited SymPy version gate; after supplying pinned SymPy 1.14.0, the whole original final release was rerun. Successful preparation and unchanged parent/native ancestry are explicitly authenticated reuse.
- Registered package replay, exact committed-byte preflight and committed export integrity checks passed. The bounded replay also regenerates both exact outer arithmetic ledgers.

Reproduce the bounded checks:
```
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/staged544-producer-return
```

The self-contained archive and full replay CLI are included. Archive extraction was tested; no fresh end-to-end execution of the new wrapper itself or no-reuse retained-parent cold run is claimed. Inherited all-size/compiler, source/hosting, precision/recovery, analytic and BIT assumptions remain. No selected certificate is changed, no packing optimum or unconditional theorem is claimed, and no fresh third-party review is claimed.

Prepared by dataisfire with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Retained authors and interpreter/engine reuse are credited in SOURCE-CREDITS.md. See PROOF.md, VALIDATION.json and evidence/RELEASE.json under research/staged544-producer-return.
